div.head: Wi 5.1[a]
div.ab: Gif hit ceorlisc man sie, gebete L scll';
Gif hit ceorlisc man sie, gebete L scll';
Gif hit ceorlisc man sie, gebete L scƚƚ.
Wenn es ein gemeinfreier Mann ist, büsse er 50 Schll.
If it is a common freeman, let him pay 50 shillings.
If a commoner does so, he shall pay 50 shillings compensation;
If it is a ceorl, he is to pay 50 shillings; and both of them are to abandon the union, with repentance.
If it is one of freeman’s rank, let him make 50 shillings restitution.
div.note: Whitelock translates Wi 5.1 as one clause, which the sheet divides into rows 5.1[a], 5.1[b]; her translation of the whole is given here, in the first row.

note.seg: Königsschutz; s. d. Gl 2. Für den Empfänger des Strafgelds braucht man nicht deshalb den König allein als möglich anzunehmen (s. o. 5²); allein es kann unter dem ungenannten Strafgeldempfänger keine andere Instanz u. 14 gemeint sein

King’s protection; see that word in Gl 2. It is not necessary on that account to assume the king alone as possible recipient of the fine (see above 5²); but no other authority can be meant by the unnamed recipient of the fine below 14
